bundle: CanDoItAll Runtime, Tools, and Process Drivers
title: Manager process ownership, supervision, and watchers

tasks.title: Create an owned launched-process registry
tasks.description: Persist non-secret PID/start identity/executable/argv hash/workspace/user/parent/lease state for Manager-launched processes and reconcile it on restart.

tasks.title: Isolate Windows WMI
tasks.description: Move ManagementObjectSearcher and System.Management calls into a Windows leaf adapter selected by composition; neutral Manager contracts do not reference WMI.

tasks.title: Implement Linux recovery discovery
tasks.description: Use `/proc` or another bounded mechanism to obtain start time, owner, executable, command, and parent where permitted. Missing evidence must not authorize termination.

tasks.title: Implement macOS recovery discovery
tasks.description: Use a tested bounded adapter (native API or strictly parsed command fixture) with locale/permission/race handling and safe fallback.

tasks.title: Strengthen ownership proof
tasks.description: Require PID plus start identity and additional registry/user/executable/command/workspace evidence. Reject name-only, substring-only, or ambiguous matches.

tasks.title: Unify launch/stop lifecycle
tasks.description: Use B01 execution primitives for dotnet watch, Tailwind/npm, tuning, and related processes; implement graceful stop then bounded force kill.

tasks.title: Make watcher pipelines convergent
tasks.description: Reuse Core watcher hint/rescan principles, generation/fingerprint output, duplicate suppression, overflow recovery, and polling fallback without merging domain-specific supervisor logic.

tasks.title: Fix path/comparer semantics
tasks.description: Remove global case-insensitive path sets and use Core C4 logical/physical rules for project references, roots, output, ignored segments, and process signatures.

tasks.title: Inject process and watcher failures
tasks.description: Test PID reuse, process exit race, unreadable command line, permission denied, orphan registry, duplicate starts, watcher overflow, rename storm, shutdown interruption, and output convergence.

tasks.title: Issue Gate R2
tasks.description: No later MCP/plugin/process adaptation begins until process ownership and Manager lifecycle are independently approved.
